hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git (commit|push)'; then if ! npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1; then printf '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"Type-check failed — fix errors before committing."}'; fi; fi
f=.claude/local/ticket-in-progress.json; if [ -f "$f" ]; then issue=$(jq -r .issue "$f"); step=$(jq -r .step "$f"); echo "Ticket in progress: issue #$issue, step: $step"; fi
